# Vendored dependency

`refiners-0.4.0-py3-none-any.whl` was built from
`finegrain-ai/refiners` commit
`7ca1774b5f8f172708db647a26c3be68858f285a` using Python 3.10 and
`python -m pip wheel --no-deps`.

Its required SHA-256 is recorded in `Tools/build_requirements_lock.py`. The
release manifest independently hashes the wheel again from the committed Git
blob. This avoids executing Git or mutable VCS dependency resolution on user
machines.
